earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 q3-2026earningsrelease.htm EX-99.1 TDY EARNINGS RELEASE Q3 2026 Document Exhibit 99.1 1049 Camino Dos Rios Thousand Oaks, CA 91360-2362 NEWS RELEASE TELEDYNE TECHNOLOGIES REPORTS THIRD QUARTER RESULTS THOUSAND OAKS, Calif. – October 21, 2026 – Teledyne Technologies Incorporated (NYSE:TDY) • All-time record quarterly sales, operating profit and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share • Third quarter net sales of $1,684.9 million, an increase of 9.4% compared with last year • Third quarter GAAP diluted earnings per share of $5.82, an increase of 25.2% compared with last year • Third quarter non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $6.72, an increase of 20.6% compared with last year • Third quarter cash from operations of $352.5 million and free cash flow of $319.5 million • Raising full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share outlook to $21.71 to $21.87 compared with the prior outlook of $20.73 to $20.99, and raising full year 2026 non-GAAP earnings per share outlook to $25.40 to $25.50, compared with the prior outlook of $24.45 to $24.65 • Announced pending acquisition of Varex Imaging Corporation for approximately $1.1 billion • Quarter-end consolidated leverage ratio of 0.9x • Stock repurchases in September and through October 19th totaling $224.6 million at a weighted average price of $607.03 per share Teledyne today reported third quarter 2026 net sales of $1,684.9 million compared with net sales of $1,539.5 million for the third quarter of 2025, an increase of 9.4%. The third quarter of 2026 net sales included $11.7 million in incremental sales from recent acquisitions. Net income attributable to Teledyne was $272.8 million ($5.82 diluted earnings per share) for the third quarter of 2026 compared with $220.7 million ($4.65 diluted earnings per share) for the third quarter of 2025, an increase of 23.6%. The third quarter of 2026 included $55.2 million of pretax acquired intangible asset amortization expense and $0.2 million of pretax transaction and integration costs. Excluding those items, non-GAAP net income attributable to Teledyne for the third quarter of 2026 was $315.1 million ($6.72 diluted earnings per share). The third quarter of 2025 included $55.1 million of pretax acquired intangible asset amortization expense, $0.7 million of pretax transaction and integration costs, $1.4 million of pretax inventory step-up expense, and $0.2 million of income tax expense from FLIR acquisition-related tax matters. Excluding those items, non-GAAP net income attributable to Teledyne for the third quarter of 2025 was $264.5 million ($5.57 diluted earnings per share). Operating margin was 20.6% for the third quarter of 2026 compared with 18.4% for the third quarter of 2025. Excluding the items discussed above, non-GAAP operating margin for the third quarter of 2026 was 23.9% compared with 22.1% for the third quarter of 2025. 1 “Our third quarter sales and operating earnings were the strongest in Teledyne’s history,” said Robert Mehrabian, Executive Chairman. “Specifically, sales and non-GAAP earnings per share increased 9.4% and 20.6%, respectively. Organic growth accelerated in our Digital Imaging segment and was led by sales of infrared detectors and subsystems for space and unmanned applications. Furthermore, each of our major commercial imaging businesses, such as industrial vision sensors & systems and healthcare, increased year-over-year. For all of Teledyne, orders exceeded sales every quarter over the last three years, and funded backlog is now nearly $5.3 billion. We were pleased to announce the pending highly-complementary Varex acquisition in August, and Varex’s special meeting is scheduled for October 28. Finally, given our continued strong cash flow, we recently made $224.6 million of opportunistic stock repurchases.” Review of Operations Comparisons are with the third quarter of 2025, unless noted otherwise. Digital Imaging The Digital Imaging segment’s third quarter 2026 net sales were $903.0 million compared with $785.4 million, an increase of 15.0%. Operating income was $182.7 million for the third quarter of 2026 compared with $123.4 million, an increase of 48.1%. Acquired intangible asset amortization expense for the third quarter of 2026 was $46.9 million compared with $46.8 million. Excluding this item, non-GAAP operating income for the third quarter of 2026 was $229.6 million compared with $170.2 million, an increase of 34.9%. Third quarter of 2026 net sales increased primarily due to higher sales of infrared imaging detectors, components and subsystems for both defense and commercial applications as well as higher sales of maritime products, integrated defense systems, industrial and scientific imaging systems, X-ray products, and surveillance systems. The third quarter of 2026 included $5.5 million of incremental Digital Imaging sales from a recent acquisition. The increase in operating income primarily reflected higher net sales and favorable product mix. Instrumentation The Instrumentation segment’s third quarter 2026 net sales were $370.5 million compared with $363.6 million, an increase of 1.9%. Operating income was $99.6 million for the third quarter of 2026 compared with $98.8 million, an increase of 0.8%. Acquired intangible asset amortization expense for the third quarter of 2026 was $3.0 million compared with $3.3 million. Excluding this item, non-GAAP operating income for the third quarter of 2026 was $102.6 million compared with $102.1 million, an increase of 0.5%. The third quarter of 2026 net sales increase resulted from an $8.3 million increase in sales of environmental instrumentation primarily due to $6.2 million of incremental sales from a recent acquisition and a $3.4 million increase in sales of marine instrumentation, partially offset by a $4.8 million decrease in sales of electronic test and measurement instrumentation. The increase in operating income primarily reflected the increase in net sales. Aerospace and Defense Electronics The Aerospace and Defense Electronics segment’s third quarter 2026 net sales were $287.4 million compared with $275.5 million, an increase of 4.3%. Operating income was $77.8 million for the third quarter of 2026 compared with $70.4 million, an increase of 10.5%. Acquired intangible asset amortization expense for the third quarter of 2026 was $5.3 million compared with $5.0 million. The third quarter of 2025 included $0.5 million of pretax transaction and integration costs with no comparable amount in the third quarter of 2026. Inventory step-up expense for the third quarter of 2025 was $1.4 million with no comparable amount in the third quarter of 2026. Excluding acquired intangible asset amortization expense, pretax transaction and integration costs, and inventory step-up expense, non-GAAP operating income for the third quarter of 2026 was $83.1 million compared with $77.3 million, an increase of 7.5%. Third quarter of 2026 net sales reflected higher sales of $16.5 million for defense electronics and lower sales of $4.6 million for aerospace electronics. The increase in operating income primarily reflected the impact of higher sales as well as improved margins at recently acquired businesses. 2 Engineered Systems The Engineered Systems segment’s third quarter 2026 net sales were $124.0 million compared with $115.0 million, an increase of 7.8%. Operating income was $13.0 million for the third quarter of 2026 compared with $12.2 million, an increase of 6.6%. Third quarter of 2026 net sales primarily reflected higher sales of engineered products. The increase in operating income was primarily driven by higher net sales. Additional Financial Information Cash Flow Cash provided by operating activities was $352.5 million for the third quarter of 2026 compared with $343.1 million, with the increase driven by favorable operating results in the third quarter of 2026 compared with 2025, partially offset by higher inventory purchases. Depreciation and amortization expense for the third quarter of 2026 was $84.7 million compared with $84.5 million. Stock-based compensation expense for the third quarter of 2026 was $12.2 million compared with $10.5 million. Capital expenditures for the third quarter of 2026 were $33.0 million compared with $29.2 million. Teledyne received $3.9 million from the exercise of stock options in the third quarter of 2026 compared with $13.0 million. As of September 27, 2026, net debt was $1,465.4 million, which is calculated as total debt of $2,027.8 million, net of cash and cash equivalents of $562.4 million. As of December 28, 2025, net debt was $2,123.0 million, representing total debt of $2,475.4 million, net of cash and cash equivalents of $352.4 million. During the third quarter of 2026, the company repurchased approximately 0.2 million of its shares for $94.8 million. As of September 27, 2026, $1,158.4 million was available under the $1.20 billion credit facility after reductions of $41.6 million in outstanding letters of credit. On August 10, 2026, Teledyne and Varex Imaging Corporation (“Varex”) entered into a definitive agreement under which Teledyne will acquire Varex in a cash transaction valued at approximately $1.1 billion, which considers Varex’s outstanding equity awards and net debt. The company plans to fund the pending acquisition from cash on hand as well as available borrowings under its credit facility. The transaction is expected to close in early 2027 and is subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals and approval by Varex’s stockholders. After close, Varex will be included within the Digital Imaging segment. Prior to entering into the agreement, Teledyne acquired approximately 1.3 million shares of Varex for $13.9 million, and during the third quarter of 2026, Teledyne recorded a $10.6 million gain within other income (expense), net, related to adjusting these shares to the market price at the end of the quarter. Third Quarter Free Cash Flow 2026 2025 Cash provided by operating activities $ 352.5 $ 343.1 Capital expenditures for property, plant and equipment (33.0) (29.2) Free cash flow $ 319.5 $ 313.9 Income Taxes The effective tax rate for the third quarter of 2026 was 21.3% compared with 19.3%. The third quarter of 2026 included net discrete income tax benefits of $1.6 million compared with $4.9 million. 3 Other Corporate expense was $25.9 million for the third quarter of 2026 compared with $22.0 million, with the increase primarily related to higher professional services as well as higher compensation costs, including incentive compensation. Non-service retirement benefit income was $2.6 million for the third quarter of 2026 compared with $2.7 million. Interest expense, net of interest income, was $10.5 million for the third quarter of 2026 compared with $12.6 million, with the decrease due to lower outstanding borrowings compared with the third quarter of 2025. Other income (expense), net, in the third quarter of 2026 primarily consisted of a mark-to-market gain on Varex shares held by Teledyne, partially offset by foreign currency exchange losses. Other income (expense), net, primarily consisted of foreign currency exchange losses in the third quarter of 2025. Outlook Based on its current outlook, the company’s management believes that fourth quarter 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $5.68 to $5.83, and full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $21.71 to $21.87. The company’s management further believes that fourth quarter 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $6.60 to $6.70, and full year 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $25.40 to $25.50. The non-GAAP outlook excludes certain transaction and integration costs and acquired intangible asset amortization.
